id-20260823-news-1.title: BJB Bank Advertising Corruption Rp223.6 Billion: KPK Detains Five Suspects, Modus Operandi of Splitting Project Packages to Avoid Auction Uncovered

segments.src: Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) menahan lima orang tersangka dalam kasus dugaan korupsi pengadaan layanan jasa iklan atau promosi PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk (Bank BJB) untuk periode 2021-2023.
segments.tr: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has detained five suspects in the alleged corruption case involving the procurement of advertising or promotion services for PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk (Bank BJB) for the 2021-2023 period.

segments.src: Penahanan dilakukan setelah penyidik menemukan indikasi kerugian keuangan negara yang ditaksir mencapai Rp223,6 miliar.
segments.tr: The detention was carried out after investigators found indications of state financial losses estimated to reach Rp223.6 billion.

segments.src: ## Lima Tersangka Ditahan Penyidik
segments.tr: ## Five Suspects Detained by Investigators

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan yang disampaikan KPK, kelima tersangka terdiri dari unsur internal Bank BJB serta pihak swasta yang diduga terlibat dalam proses pengadaan iklan dan kegiatan promosi bank pelat merah milik Pemerintah Provinsi Jawa Barat tersebut.
segments.tr: Based on information provided by the KPK, the five suspects consist of internal elements of Bank BJB and private parties allegedly involved in the procurement process of advertising and promotional activities for the state-owned bank belonging to the West Java Provincial Government.

segments.src: Demi menjaga asas praduga tak bersalah, identitas lengkap para tersangka untuk sementara dipublikasikan menggunakan inisial hingga proses hukum berjalan lebih lanjut.
segments.tr: To maintain the principle of presumption of innocence, the complete identities of the suspects are temporarily published using initials until the legal process proceeds further.

segments.src: Penahanan dilakukan di Rumah Tahanan (Rutan) KPK guna kepentingan penyidikan lanjutan.
segments.tr: The detention is carried out at the KPK Detention Center (Rutan) for the purpose of further investigation.

segments.src: Tim penyidik menegaskan bahwa langkah penahanan diambil untuk mencegah tersangka melarikan diri, menghilangkan barang bukti, maupun mengulangi perbuatan yang disangkakan.
segments.tr: The investigation team emphasized that the detention step was taken to prevent suspects from fleeing, eliminating evidence, or repeating the alleged actions.

segments.src: ## Modus Pecah Paket Proyek Iklan
segments.tr: ## Modus Operandi of Splitting Advertising Project Packages

segments.src: Dari hasil penyidikan sementara, KPK mengungkap dugaan modus operandi berupa pemecahan nilai kontrak pengadaan jasa iklan menjadi beberapa paket kecil.
segments.tr: From the preliminary investigation results, the KPK uncovered an alleged modus operandi in the form of splitting the value of advertising service procurement contracts into several small packages.

segments.src: Praktik ini diduga sengaja dilakukan agar nilai masing-masing paket berada di bawah ambang batas yang mewajibkan proses lelang atau tender terbuka, sehingga penunjukan vendor dapat dilakukan secara langsung tanpa kompetisi yang wajar.
segments.tr: This practice is suspected to have been intentionally carried out so that the value of each package falls below the threshold that requires an open auction or tender process, so that vendor appointment can be done directly without fair competition.

segments.src: Dengan skema tersebut, sejumlah pihak yang diduga telah "diatur" sejak awal disebut mendapatkan proyek promosi Bank BJB secara berulang selama periode 2021 hingga 2023.
segments.tr: With this scheme, several parties suspected of having been "arranged" from the beginning were said to have obtained Bank BJB promotion projects repeatedly during the period from 2021 to 2023.

segments.src: Penyidik masih mendalami aliran dana serta pihak-pihak lain yang kemungkinan turut menikmati keuntungan dari proyek pengadaan tersebut.
segments.tr: Investigators are still examining the flow of funds and other parties who may have also enjoyed profits from the procurement project.

segments.src: ## Kerugian Negara Ditaksir Rp223,6 Miliar
segments.tr: ## State Losses Estimated at Rp223.6 Billion

segments.src: KPK menyebut nilai kerugian keuangan negara dalam perkara ini sementara dihitung mencapai Rp223,6 miliar.
segments.tr: The KPK stated that the value of state financial losses in this case is provisionally calculated to reach Rp223.6 billion.

segments.src: Angka tersebut merupakan hasil audit dan kajian awal penyidik, yang kemungkinan dapat berubah seiring berjalannya proses penyidikan serta hasil audit resmi dari lembaga yang berwenang seperti Badan Pemeriksa Keuangan (BPK) atau Badan Pengawasan Keuangan dan Pembangunan (BPKP).
segments.tr: This figure is the result of an initial audit and review by investigators, which may change along with the progress of the investigation and official audit results from authorized institutions such as the Audit Board (BPK) or the Financial and Development Supervisory Agency (BPKP).

segments.src: Sebagai bank milik daerah yang sebagian sahamnya dimiliki pemerintah provinsi dan kabupaten/kota se-Jawa Barat serta Banten, dugaan penyimpangan dalam pengelolaan anggaran promosi Bank BJB ini turut menjadi sorotan publik karena berkaitan langsung dengan penggunaan dana yang bersumber dari keuangan daerah.
segments.tr: As a regional bank whose shares are partly owned by the provincial and regency/city governments throughout West Java and Banten, the alleged irregularities in the management of Bank BJB's promotion budget have also become a public spotlight because they are directly related to the use of funds sourced from regional finances.

segments.src: ## Proses Hukum Masih Berlanjut
segments.tr: ## Legal Process Still Ongoing

segments.src: Juru bicara KPK menyatakan bahwa penetapan tersangka dan penahanan merupakan bagian dari rangkaian proses penyidikan yang masih terus berjalan.
segments.tr: The KPK spokesperson stated that the naming of suspects and detention are part of a series of legal processes that are still ongoing.

segments.src: KPK membuka kemungkinan adanya penambahan tersangka baru maupun pengembangan perkara ke arah pihak-pihak lain yang diduga turut terlibat, termasuk kemungkinan penerapan pasal pencucian uang apabila ditemukan indikasi penyembunyian aset hasil korupsi.
segments.tr: The KPK opens up the possibility of adding new suspects and developing the case toward other parties allegedly involved, including the possibility of applying money laundering articles if indications of concealing assets from corruption are found.

segments.src: Para tersangka disangkakan melanggar Undang-Undang Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Korupsi.
segments.tr: The suspects are suspected of violating the Corruption Eradication Law.

segments.src: Sesuai prinsip praduga tak bersalah, status tersangka belum berarti yang bersangkutan terbukti bersalah secara hukum.
segments.tr: In accordance with the principle of presumption of innocence, the status of a suspect does not yet mean that the person concerned is legally proven guilty.

segments.src: Pembuktian akan dilakukan melalui proses persidangan di Pengadilan Tindak Pidana Korupsi (Tipikor), di mana para tersangka berhak mengajukan pembelaan dan keterangan sesuai mekanisme hukum yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Proof will be carried out through a trial process at the Corruption Court (Tipikor), where the suspects have the right to submit defenses and testimonies in accordance with applicable legal mechanisms.

segments.src: ## Komitmen Pemberantasan Korupsi di Sektor Perbankan Daerah
segments.tr: ## Commitment to Eradicating Corruption in the Regional Banking Sector

segments.src: Kasus ini menjadi pengingat pentingnya tata kelola pengadaan barang dan jasa yang transparan, khususnya pada badan usaha milik daerah yang mengelola dana publik.
segments.tr: This case serves as a reminder of the importance of transparent goods and services procurement governance, especially in regional state-owned enterprises that manage public funds.

segments.src: Publik diharapkan terus mengawal proses hukum ini secara objektif sembari menunggu hasil penyidikan dan persidangan yang berlangsung secara resmi melalui lembaga yang berwenang.
segments.tr: The public is expected to continue overseeing this legal process objectively while waiting for the results of the investigation and trial taking place officially through authorized institutions.

segments.src: KPK mengimbau masyarakat maupun pihak internal perusahaan pelat merah untuk aktif berpartisipasi melaporkan dugaan penyimpangan melalui kanal pengaduan resmi, sebagai bagian dari upaya bersama mewujudkan tata kelola pengadaan yang bersih dan akuntabel.
segments.tr: The KPK urges the public and internal parties of the state-owned enterprise to actively participate in reporting alleged irregularities through official complaint channels, as part of joint efforts to realize clean and accountable procurement governance.

id-20260823-news-3.title: Prabowo Claims RI Economy is the Highest in 13 Years and Optimistic About Reaching 6 Percent, Here Are the Fact-Check Results

segments.src: Pernyataan Presiden Prabowo Subianto soal pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia kembali menjadi sorotan publik.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto's statement regarding Indonesia's economic growth has once again become a public spotlight.

segments.src: Dalam sejumlah kesempatan, Presiden menyampaikan optimisme bahwa laju pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional pada akhir 2026 dapat menembus angka 6 persen, sekaligus mengklaimnya sebagai capaian tertinggi dalam 13 tahun terakhir.
segments.tr: On several occasions, the President expressed optimism that the national economic growth rate by the end of 2026 could break the 6 percent mark, while simultaneously claiming it as the highest achievement in the last 13 years.

segments.src: Klaim ini menarik perhatian karena menyangkut indikator makro yang berdampak langsung pada kehidupan masyarakat, mulai dari lapangan kerja, daya beli, hingga investasi.
segments.tr: This claim is attracting attention because it concerns macroeconomic indicators that directly impact people's lives, ranging from job opportunities and purchasing power to investment.

segments.src: ## Isi Klaim yang Beredar
segments.tr: ## Content of the Circulating Claim

segments.src: Narasi yang berkembang di ruang publik menyebutkan bahwa pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia tahun ini disebut-sebut sebagai yang tertinggi sejak sekitar tahun 2013.
segments.tr: The narrative developing in the public sphere mentions that Indonesia's economic growth this year is being touted as the highest since around 2013.

segments.src: Angka 6 persen turut disebut sebagai target optimistis yang ingin dicapai pemerintah pada akhir tahun anggaran berjalan.
segments.tr: The 6 percent figure is also mentioned as an optimistic target that the government wants to achieve by the end of the current fiscal year.

segments.src: Pernyataan semacam ini lazim disampaikan dalam forum resmi maupun pidato kenegaraan sebagai bentuk komunikasi capaian kinerja pemerintah kepada publik.
segments.tr: Statements of this kind are commonly delivered in official forums or state addresses as a form of communicating the government's performance achievements to the public.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Klaim Ini Perlu Diverifikasi
segments.tr: ## Why This Claim Needs Verification

segments.src: Setiap klaim angka pertumbuhan ekonomi pada dasarnya bersifat terukur dan dapat diverifikasi, karena Indonesia memiliki lembaga resmi yang berwenang merilis data tersebut, yakni Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS).
segments.tr: Every claim regarding economic growth figures is inherently measurable and verifiable, because Indonesia has an official institution authorized to release such data, namely the Central Statistics Agency (BPS).

segments.src: Publikasi resmi BPS biasanya memuat pertumbuhan produk domestik bruto (PDB) secara triwulanan (year-on-year dan quarter-to-quarter) serta akumulasi sepanjang tahun berjalan.
segments.tr: Official BPS publications usually contain quarterly gross domestic product (GDP) growth (year-on-year and quarter-to-quarter) as well as the accumulation throughout the current year.

segments.src: Untuk menilai keakuratan klaim "tertinggi dalam 13 tahun", setidaknya ada beberapa hal yang perlu dicocokkan:
segments.tr: To assess the accuracy of the "highest in 13 years" claim, there are at least a few things that need to be cross-checked:

segments.src: 1. **Data pembanding historis** – Pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia pasca-2013 tercatat bervariasi, sempat berada di kisaran 5 persen pada beberapa tahun sebelum pandemi, anjlok tajam saat pandemi COVID-19 tahun 2020, lalu berangsur pulih ke kisaran 5 persen pada tahun-tahun setelahnya. Klaim "tertinggi dalam 13 tahun" berarti mengklaim melampaui seluruh angka pada rentang tersebut, sehingga perlu dicocokkan satu per satu dengan rilis resmi BPS pada tahun-tahun bersangkutan.
segments.tr: 1. **Historical comparison data** – Indonesia's economic growth post-2013 has been recorded as varied, hovering in the 5 percent range in the years before the pandemic, dropping sharply during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, and then gradually recovering to the 5 percent range in the years that followed. The claim of "highest in 13 years" means claiming to exceed all figures in that range, so it needs to be cross-checked one by one with official BPS releases for the years in question.

segments.src: 2. **Data realisasi kuartal berjalan** – Angka pertumbuhan hingga 6 persen pada akhir 2026 merupakan proyeksi atau target, bukan angka final yang sudah dirilis. Untuk mengujinya, publik perlu menunggu dan membandingkan dengan rilis resmi pertumbuhan ekonomi kuartal I dan kuartal II 2026 yang dipublikasikan BPS, karena capaian akhir tahun baru dapat dipastikan setelah data empat kuartal tersedia secara lengkap.
segments.tr: 2. **Current quarter realization data** – A growth figure of up to 6 percent by the end of 2026 is a projection or target, not a final figure that has already been released. To test it, the public needs to wait and compare it with the official releases of economic growth for the first and second quarters of 2026 published by BPS, because the year-end achievement can only be confirmed after data for all four quarters is fully available.

segments.src: 3. **Metode perhitungan yang digunakan** – Perlu dicermati apakah angka yang dirujuk merupakan pertumbuhan tahunan (year-on-year), kumulatif sepanjang tahun (c-to-c), atau proyeksi lembaga tertentu seperti Kementerian Keuangan, Bank Indonesia, maupun lembaga internasional. Perbedaan metode ini dapat menghasilkan angka yang berbeda meski membicarakan periode yang sama.
segments.tr: 3. **Calculation method used** – It is necessary to scrutinize whether the referenced figure is annual growth (year-on-year), cumulative throughout the year (c-to-c), or a projection from a certain institution such as the Ministry of Finance, Bank Indonesia, or international institutions. Differences in these methods can produce different figures even when discussing the same period.

segments.src: ## Konteks yang Perlu Diperhatikan
segments.tr: ## Context to Consider

segments.src: Optimisme pemerintah terhadap capaian pertumbuhan ekonomi bukan hal yang tidak lazim, apalagi di tengah upaya mendorong investasi dan kepercayaan pasar.
segments.tr: The government's optimism regarding economic growth achievements is not unusual, especially amidst efforts to boost investment and market confidence.

segments.src: Namun, publik dan media perlu membedakan antara **pernyataan optimisme atau target** dengan **data resmi yang telah terverifikasi**.
segments.tr: However, the public and media need to distinguish between **statements of optimism or targets** and **official data that has been verified**.

segments.src: Selama data kuartal III dan kuartal IV 2026 belum dirilis lengkap oleh BPS, klaim capaian akhir tahun sebaiknya diposisikan sebagai proyeksi, bukan fakta final.
segments.tr: As long as the data for the third and fourth quarters of 2026 have not been released in full by BPS, claims of year-end achievements should be positioned as projections, not final facts.

segments.src: Penting juga untuk memperhatikan bahwa perbandingan "tertinggi dalam X tahun" idealnya disertai rujukan data pembanding yang jelas dan sumber resminya, agar publik dapat menelusuri sendiri kebenarannya tanpa harus bergantung pada satu pernyataan pejabat semata.
segments.tr: It is also important to note that comparisons of "highest in X years" should ideally be accompanied by clear comparative data references and their official sources, so that the public can trace the truth themselves without having to rely solely on one official's statement.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan Sementara
segments.tr: ## Preliminary Conclusion

segments.src: Berdasarkan penelusuran, klaim pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia menembus 6 persen dan menjadi yang tertinggi dalam 13 tahun masih berstatus **optimisme dan target pemerintah**, dan belum sepenuhnya dapat dipastikan kebenarannya karena bergantung pada rilis data resmi BPS untuk periode kuartal I, II, III, dan IV 2026 secara utuh.
segments.tr: Based on the investigation, the claim that Indonesia's economic growth will reach 6 percent and be the highest in 13 years is still in the status of **government optimism and targets**, and its truth cannot be fully confirmed yet because it depends on the full release of official BPS data for the first, second, third, and fourth quarters of 2026.

segments.src: Masyarakat disarankan untuk memantau langsung situs resmi BPS (bps.go.id) serta rilis resmi Kementerian Keuangan dan Bank Indonesia guna mendapatkan angka pertumbuhan ekonomi yang akurat dan terkini, sebelum menyimpulkan benar atau tidaknya klaim tersebut secara utuh.
segments.tr: The public is advised to monitor the official BPS website (bps.go.id) directly as well as official releases from the Ministry of Finance and Bank Indonesia to obtain accurate and up-to-date economic growth figures, before concluding whether or not the claim is entirely true.

segments.src: Sikap kritis dan kebiasaan mengecek data ke sumber resmi merupakan langkah penting agar masyarakat tidak mudah terjebak pada narasi sepihak, baik yang bernada terlalu optimistis maupun terlalu pesimistis, dalam membaca kondisi perekonomian nasional.
segments.tr: A critical attitude and the habit of checking data against official sources are important steps so that the public is not easily trapped by one-sided narratives, whether they are overly optimistic or overly pessimistic, when reading the state of the national economy.

id-20260823-news-2.title: Economic Census 2026 Targeted to Complete by End of August, Results Potentially Change Social Assistance Recipient Data

segments.src: ## Pendataan Sudah Tembus 88 Persen Secara Nasional
segments.tr: ## Data Collection Has Reached 88 Percent Nationally

segments.src: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) melaporkan bahwa pelaksanaan Sensus Ekonomi 2026 telah mencapai sekitar 88 persen cakupan secara nasional per pertengahan Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The Central Statistics Agency (BPS) reported that the implementation of the 2026 Economic Census has reached approximately 88 percent nationwide coverage as of mid-August 2026.

segments.src: Dengan capaian tersebut, BPS menargetkan seluruh proses pendataan bisa rampung 100 persen sebelum akhir bulan ini.
segments.tr: With this achievement, BPS targets the entire data collection process to be 100 percent complete before the end of this month.

segments.src: Sensus Ekonomi merupakan kegiatan pendataan menyeluruh terhadap unit usaha di Indonesia, mulai dari usaha mikro dan kecil di tingkat rumah tangga hingga perusahaan skala menengah dan besar.
segments.tr: The Economic Census is a comprehensive data collection activity of business units in Indonesia, ranging from micro and small businesses at the household level to medium and large scale enterprises.

segments.src: Data yang dikumpulkan mencakup jenis usaha, skala omzet, jumlah tenaga kerja, hingga kondisi ekonomi pelaku usaha di lapangan.
segments.tr: The data collected includes the type of business, turnover scale, number of workers, to the economic conditions of business actors in the field.

segments.src: Petugas sensus dikerahkan ke berbagai wilayah, termasuk daerah dengan akses terbatas, sehingga proses verifikasi di lapangan membutuhkan waktu tambahan pada tahap-tahap akhir.
segments.tr: Census officers were deployed to various regions, including areas with limited access, so the field verification process required additional time in the final stages.

segments.src: ## Kaitan dengan Data Tunggal Sosial Ekonomi Nasional (DTSEN)
segments.tr: ## Connection with the National Socio-Economic Single Data (DTSEN)

segments.src: Yang membuat sensus kali ini mendapat perhatian lebih luas adalah keterkaitannya dengan Data Tunggal Sosial Ekonomi Nasional (DTSEN), basis data yang selama ini digunakan pemerintah untuk menentukan kelompok desil ekonomi masyarakat sekaligus menjadi acuan penyaluran berbagai program bantuan sosial (bansos).
segments.tr: What makes this census receive broader attention is its connection to the National Socio-Economic Single Data (DTSEN), a database that has been used by the government to determine the community's economic decile groups while also serving as a reference for the distribution of various social assistance (bansos) programs.

segments.src: Menurut keterangan yang disampaikan otoritas terkait, hasil Sensus Ekonomi 2026 akan digunakan sebagai salah satu bahan evaluasi untuk memutakhirkan klasifikasi desil dalam DTSEN.
segments.tr: According to statements conveyed by relevant authorities, the results of the 2026 Economic Census will be used as one of the evaluation materials to update the decile classification in DTSEN.

segments.src: Pembaruan ini dianggap penting mengingat kondisi ekonomi rumah tangga dan pelaku usaha dapat berubah dari waktu ke waktu, sementara data lama berisiko tidak lagi mencerminkan situasi terkini di lapangan.
segments.tr: This update is considered important given that the economic conditions of households and business actors can change from time to time, while old data runs the risk of no longer reflecting the latest situation in the field.

segments.src: ## Keluhan Warga soal Klasifikasi Desil
segments.tr: ## Resident Complaints Regarding Decile Classification

segments.src: Belakangan ini, sejumlah warga menyampaikan keluhan terkait klasifikasi desil dalam DTSEN yang dinilai belum sepenuhnya akurat.
segments.tr: Lately, a number of residents have expressed complaints regarding the decile classification in DTSEN which is considered not yet fully accurate.

segments.src: Ada laporan warga yang merasa kondisi ekonominya seharusnya masuk kategori penerima bantuan namun tercatat pada desil yang lebih tinggi, maupun sebaliknya.
segments.tr: There are reports of residents who feel their economic conditions should fall into the assistance recipient category but are recorded in a higher decile, or vice versa.

segments.src: Keluhan semacam ini disampaikan melalui berbagai kanal pengaduan resmi di tingkat desa, kelurahan, hingga dinas sosial setempat.
segments.tr: Complaints of this kind are conveyed through various official complaint channels at the village, sub-district, to local social service levels.

segments.src: Pemerintah menyatakan keluhan tersebut menjadi salah satu pertimbangan mengapa pemutakhiran data melalui Sensus Ekonomi 2026 dinilai mendesak.
segments.tr: The government stated that these complaints are one of the considerations why data updating through the 2026 Economic Census is considered urgent.

segments.src: Dengan data yang lebih baru dan lebih rinci mengenai kondisi ekonomi masyarakat, diharapkan proses penentuan kelayakan penerima bansos dapat lebih tepat sasaran.
segments.tr: With newer and more detailed data regarding the economic conditions of the community, it is hoped that the process of determining the eligibility of social assistance recipients can be more targeted.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Bisa Berubah Setelah Sensus Rampung
segments.tr: ## What Can Change After the Census is Complete

segments.src: Setelah tahap pendataan lapangan tuntas, BPS akan melanjutkan proses pengolahan dan validasi data sebelum hasilnya diserahkan sebagai bahan masukan bagi kementerian dan lembaga terkait, termasuk pihak yang mengelola DTSEN.
segments.tr: After the field data collection stage is completed, BPS will continue the data processing and validation process before the results are submitted as input for relevant ministries and institutions, including those managing DTSEN.

segments.src: Proses evaluasi ulang desil ekonomi biasanya melibatkan pencocokan data lapangan dengan basis data yang sudah ada, sehingga perubahan status desil seseorang atau suatu rumah tangga dimungkinkan terjadi, baik naik maupun turun.
segments.tr: The re-evaluation process of economic deciles usually involves matching field data with existing databases, so changes to the decile status of an individual or a household are possible, either going up or down.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, ada baiknya memastikan data yang tercatat pada saat pendataan sensus maupun data kependudukan lainnya sudah sesuai dengan kondisi terkini.
segments.tr: For the public, it is advisable to ensure that the data recorded during the census data collection or other population data matches the current conditions.

segments.src: Warga yang merasa terdapat ketidaksesuaian data dapat menyampaikan pembaruan melalui perangkat desa/kelurahan atau kanal resmi dinas sosial setempat agar proses verifikasi berjalan lebih lancar.
segments.tr: Residents who feel there is a data mismatch can submit updates through village/sub-district officials or the official channels of the local social service so that the verification process runs more smoothly.

segments.src: ## Menunggu Hasil Resmi
segments.tr: ## Waiting for Official Results

segments.src: Hingga saat ini, pemerintah belum merilis jadwal pasti kapan hasil evaluasi ulang desil DTSEN berdasarkan Sensus Ekonomi 2026 akan diumumkan secara resmi.
segments.tr: Until now, the government has not released an exact schedule of when the results of the DTSEN decile re-evaluation based on the 2026 Economic Census will be officially announced.

segments.src: Masyarakat disarankan untuk terus memantau informasi resmi dari BPS maupun Kementerian Sosial agar tidak terjebak kabar yang belum terverifikasi terkait perubahan status penerima bansos.
segments.tr: The public is advised to continue monitoring official information from BPS and the Ministry of Social Affairs so as not to get caught up in unverified news regarding changes in social assistance recipient status.

segments.src: Proses pemutakhiran data berskala nasional seperti ini memang membutuhkan waktu, namun langkah tersebut dinilai penting agar penyaluran bantuan sosial ke depan bisa lebih akurat dan sesuai dengan kondisi ekonomi riil masyarakat Indonesia.
segments.tr: A national-scale data updating process like this indeed takes time, but this step is considered important so that the distribution of social assistance going forward can be more accurate and in accordance with the real economic conditions of the Indonesian people.
